select.label: Select
select.description: Select and move joints, bars or plates

hint.boxing: Drag to box-select; release to confirm

pan.label: Pan
pan.description: Pan the view with a middle-drag or by holding H

hint.idle: Drag to pan the view; scroll to zoom

bar.label: Bar
bar.description: Draw a rigid bar between two points

hint.idle: Click to start a bar; an end on a joint or on another link is pinned there automatically
hint.drawing: Length {{length}} · angle {{angle}}° — click or type a value and ⏎
hint.zeroLength: Move the cursor before clicking: a bar can't have zero length

plate.label: Plate
plate.description: Draw a polygon plate with multiple vertices

hint.idle: Click to add vertices; Enter closes the plate
hint.needThree: Add at least 3 vertices before closing the plate
hint.drawing: {{count}} vertices — click to add, click the first one or Enter to close

groundPivot.label: Ground pivot
groundPivot.description: Pin a point of a link to ground

hint.idle: Click a link to pin it to ground there, or empty space to place a ground pivot
hint.onLink: Click to pin {{link}} to ground here
hint.empty: Click to place a ground pivot here; start a bar on it to use it
hint.alreadyGround: That point is already pinned to ground

pin.label: Pin
pin.description: Join two links with a revolute joint, anywhere on them

hint.idle: Click where two links meet to pin them, or click one link and then the other
hint.noTarget: Nothing to pin here: move over a link or a joint
hint.oneLink: Click to start a pin on {{link}}, then click the other link
hint.pickSecond: Click a point on another link to pin it to {{link}}; Esc cancels
hint.pinTo: Click to pin {{link}} to {{target}}; they are pulled together when you simulate
hint.needLink: Click on a link or a joint
hint.differentLink: Pick a point on a different link
hint.alreadyPinned: Those two links are already pinned together here

slider.label: Slider
slider.description: Create a prismatic joint with a sliding axis

hint.idle: Click a site and drag the axis direction
hint.aim: Aim the axis (15° steps) or type the angle and ⏎ — angle {{angle}}°

motor.label: Motor
motor.description: Add a motor to an existing joint

hint.idle: Click a joint to add a motor

marker.label: Trace point
marker.description: Add a trace point on a link

hint.idle: Click on a link to add a marker
hint.needLink: Click on a link that isn't ground

vertex.label: Edit shape
vertex.description: Reshape a plate's outline or bend a bar: move vertices, add arcs and curves

hint.idle: Click a plate or a bar to edit its shape
hint.plateSelected: Drag a vertex to move it; drag an edge's midpoint to add a vertex, Shift+drag to bend it
hint.barSelected: Drag a segment's midpoint to bend it; click it for more options
hint.vertexSelected: Drag to move; Delete removes the vertex
hint.minVertices: A plate needs at least 3 vertices
hint.edgeSelected: Choose Line, Arc or Curve above the edge; Delete straightens it

brush.label: Brush
brush.description: Draw freehand notes on top of the mechanism

hint.idle: Drag to draw a note; pick its color and width at the top left
hint.painting: Release to finish the stroke; Esc discards it

hint.idle: Click or drag across notes to erase them
hint.erasing: Drag across the notes to erase
hint.empty: There are no notes to erase

spring.label: Spring
spring.description: Connect two links with a spring-damper

hint.idle: Click a joint or a link to start a spring; empty space anchors it to ground
hint.pickSecond: Click a point on another link, or empty space for ground
hint.differentLink: Pick a point on a different link
